summary: Thirty-foot L-4 cab tower built in 1938 in Idaho County, Idaho, abandoned in 1950; the Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists it as gone.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists Tower Gone

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Hike-In

events.note: 30-foot tower with L-4 cab, atop the northeast point
Firelookout.com and the Idaho County list both give 1950

evidence.supports: About 12 miles north-northeast of Elk City
Nez Perce National Forest; Section 34 entry
Forest Service list calls it an L-4 pole tower
Forest Service list gives abandonment in the 1950s
Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists Tower Gone
Idaho Fire Lookouts tags site Hike-In

evidence.quote: We don't yet have a documented staffing history for this lookout.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Idaho County list give 1950; the Forest Service list says the 1950s. The story uses 1950, which the three agree on.

notes_for_editor: Story is about 123 words. Three sources agree on the 1938 build and the 1950 abandonment; the Forest Service list gives the 1950s. Height 9.1 m is converted from the 30-foot figure. The brief lists the county as Idaho; the sources give Idaho County. Access is left out because no source gives a public-access level, only the Hike-In tag. No source describes what remains at the site.
